# The small tags over a pane (where the link under ⌘ goes; what a split
# without a header runs, under the pointer) read on their ground in the
# appearance the pane has — changed while they show, too. (Their grounds
# were made once, in the appearance of that moment: light text on a light
# ground with a dark window theme on a light system.) The config has
# pane-headers = never.
type:echo see https://example.com/tag-check
key:enter
wait:0.5
appearance:dark
cmd-hover:https://example.com/tag-check
expect-link-preview:https://example.com/tag-check
appearance:light
expect-link-preview:https://example.com/tag-check
appearance:dark
expect-link-preview:https://example.com/tag-check
action:new_split:right
wait:0.8
expect-panes:2
type:cd /tmp
key:enter
wait:0.6
hover:2
expect-name-tag:tmp
appearance:light
expect-name-tag:tmp
appearance:dark
expect-name-tag:tmp
